changelog: **Postal campaigns — outbound acquisition through the one lawful cold channel** (#2697). New `/admin/acquisition` (`companies` module, ADMIN): a campaign records its data source (Art. 14(2)(f)) and a written balancing of interests (Art. 6(1)(f)), picks accounts with their eligibility (`src/lib/postCampaignRule.ts`: objected, block-listed, revoked, no address, or a letter in the last 90 days are refused — again on the server), prints DIN 5008 form-B letters at `/print/post-campaign/<id>` with the Art. 14 + Art. 21 notice on the back and a QR + short link `/b/<code>` (→ `utm_source=brief&utm_medium=post`), and locks for good once marked as posted. Results count the demo requests that came through the link. New models `PostCampaign`, `PostCampaignRecipient`, `ContactSuppression` (all in `TENANT_MODELS`). An admin can now record an owner's Art. 21 objection on the account page: all three channels revoked with `revokedVia = 'OBJECTION'` (locked like `LINK`) and the account's keys HMAC'd onto a block list that outlives the account. `operatorIdentity` is per world: `MARKETING_OPERATOR_*` names the marketing product's provider on the marketing host's imprint/privacy/trust/accessibility pages and on every letter (forwarded by both deploy scripts). New dependency: `qrcode`. Docs: `docs/marketing-vertical/postal-campaigns.md`, `go-live-checklist.md` (#2581).

en: Postal campaigns: win new customers by letter — the one cold channel German law allows. Pick accounts, print letters with the privacy notice on the back, and see every demo request that came through the letter’s link.
Record an advertising objection on an account: every channel is blocked for good, even if the account is later deleted.
tr: Posta kampanyaları: Alman hukukunun izin verdiği tek soğuk kanalla, mektupla yeni müşteri kazanın. Hesapları seçin, arkasında gizlilik notu olan mektupları yazdırın ve mektubun linkinden gelen her demo talebini görün.
Bir hesapta reklam itirazını kaydedin: hesap sonradan silinse bile bütün kanallar kalıcı olarak kapanır.
de: Briefkampagnen: Neukunden per Brief gewinnen — über den einzigen kalten Kanal, den das deutsche Recht erlaubt. Accounts auswählen, Briefe mit Datenschutzhinweis auf der Rückseite drucken und jede Demo-Anfrage sehen, die über den Link im Brief kam.
Werbewiderspruch am Account erfassen: Alle Kanäle sind dauerhaft gesperrt, auch wenn der Account später gelöscht wird.
